verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a local model runner could plausibly serve embedding models. However, nothing in the pack mentions embedding models, an embeddings endpoint, or retrieval and search use cases. The REST API (ollama-gh-4) and the partial OpenAI compatibility (ollama-docs-12) are described only generically. The community remark about 'embedding them into our product' (ollama-comm-14) refers to building LLMs into a product, not to embedding models.
